evidence: Risks related to the use or application of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence and machine learning also may be used for certain cybersecurity attacks, improving or expanding the existing capabilities of threat actors in manners we cannot predict at this time

Risks relating to the adoption, use or application of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence may impact financial results and could result in reputational and financial harm and liability
It is possible that we may not leverage this technological change as effectively as our competitors

our use of AI may also increase vulnerability to cybersecurity risks, including through unauthorized use or misuse of AI tools and bad inputs or logic or the introduction of malicious code incorporated into AI generated code
ai_positioning.summary: CRUS adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques (cybersécurité, concurrence, conformité) plutôt que sur les opportunités stratégiques. L'entreprise reconnaît utiliser l'IA en interne mais craint de ne pas en tirer parti aussi efficacement que ses concurrents.
